final_answer:
Reliability
Use fault-isolated boundaries to limit the impact of failures; test resilience and recovery processes regularly; plan disaster recovery around business recovery objectives. [AWS-WAF p.44]

Cost Optimization
Select resource type, size, and count from workload data; use cost modeling or proof-of-concept measurements before committing capacity; minimize waste from unnecessary or oversized resources. [AWS-WAF p.859]

Security
Apply identity and access management controls; protect sensitive data at rest and in transit; include infrastructure protection; use logging and monitoring for visibility. [AWS-WAF p.284]
